# Class names WebBlocks UI defines, for the pinned runtime.
#
# The admin loads the UI from a CDN, so a test cannot read the real
# stylesheet. This snapshot stands in for it. Regenerate it whenever
# WebBlocks::UI_VERSION moves — UiClassContractTest fails if the two
# disagree, which is the point: a runtime bump that drops a class the
# admin uses should be caught here rather than in a screenshot.
#
